name: Kaelaverse: Pemascape
description:
In the countryside lived a renowned blacksmith and her band of assistants. This blacksmith's forge was well known by many to be one of the best in the land! 

One day, the blacksmith known as Kaela Kovalskia has suddenly gone missing! Completely lost on what to do, Kaela's assistants, known as the Pemaloe, sets off to find her.

Play as Pemaloe in this action puzzle platformer to adventure through caves, dungeons, mine shafts, and more to find the hidden secrets of the ancient underground forge. Solve puzzles, fight off possessed monsters, and jump your way through dungeons to learn the truth of Kaela Kovalskia's whereabouts.
